A tidyverse-compatible view onto the cached dbSNP Parquet files

Source: R/query.R
dbsnp_tbl.Rd

Returns a lazy dplyr/dbplyr table backed by a duckdb connection reading the Parquet files that dbsnp_build_chrom() cached, so that ordinary dplyr::filter(), dplyr::select(), dplyr::mutate(), dplyr::arrange(), and dplyr::collect() calls work directly against the cache. Nothing is read into memory until collect() (or another action, such as print() or pull()) is called: duckdb pushes the translated SQL predicate down into the Parquet scan.

Usage

dbsnp_tbl(
  table = c("by_pos", "by_rsid"),
  chrom = NULL,
  release = "b157",
  build = "GRCh38",
  cache = dbsnp_cache(),
  con = NULL
)

Arguments

table

Which sort order to read: "by_pos" (sorted by position; best for range queries) or "by_rsid" (sorted by rsID; best for rsID lookups).

chrom

Optional chromosome, or vector of chromosomes, to restrict to (e.g. "17"). Defaults to every cached chromosome for the given table.

release

dbSNP release label used when caching (e.g. "b157").

build

Genome build label used when caching (e.g. "GRCh38").

cache

A BiocFileCache::BiocFileCache() object; defaults to dbsnp_cache().

con

An existing duckdb DBI::dbConnect() connection to reuse; defaults to opening a fresh in-process duckdb connection. Close it with dbsnp_disconnect() when done (or let it be garbage-collected).

Value

A tbl_duckdb_connection / tbl_sql object: a lazy dplyr table with columns chrom, pos, rs, ref, alt, n_alt.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
library(dplyr)
chr17 <- dbsnp_tbl("by_pos", chrom = "17")
chr17 |>
  filter(pos >= 38077296, pos <= 38083854, n_alt == 1) |>
  select(pos, rs, ref, alt) |>
  collect()
dbsnp_disconnect(chr17)
} # }
